scope: Ninth batch: fixes from the independent Fable 5.1 reviews — Mutter nativehdr8, Wine DisplayMonitor fixes, libdisplay-info hdr9 packaging

mutter.environment: Ubuntu 26.10 amd64 container, gcc 15.3.0, meson 1.10.1, -Dwerror=true; llvmpipe software rendering

first_run.mutter:color-hdr: FAIL (/color-hdr/gamut/curve-form: its sampling loop visited one distance twice, so 'strictly increasing' compared equal values)

fast_lane.fix: Test-only: the second sampling range starts one step later
fast_lane.not_invalidated: Only the color-hdr test source changed; the compositor libraries are those of the first run

mutter.binary_note: The color-hdr hash is the rebuilt test after the fix; the other binaries are from the first run

wine.tested_vs_candidate: The candidate adds one comment-only commit (0017) to the tested tree
wine.runtime: WineHQ wine-stable 11.0 (Ubuntu 24.04) in a disposable container, candidate modules overlaid before a fresh prefix, WINEDLLOVERRIDES=mscoree,mshtml=, Xvfb
wine.unchanged_overlaid_modules: user32, setupapi, cfgmgr32 and windows.devices.enumeration from the fifth-batch build (no source change affects them)

fast_lane.count_note: The fifth-batch run counted 14 displayconfig tests and this one 13, with no failures or skips in either. user32_test.exe was rebuilt (its hash differs from the fifth batch): displayconfig.c includes the changed wine/monitor.h and wingdi.h, and win32u's output-technology handling changed (patch 0014). The one-test difference was not investigated.

wine.harness_note: A first attempt hung in wineboot before any test ran (the harness lacked the installer-dialog override); with it restored the run completed, so this is not a rerun of a failed check.

libdisplay_info.note: Packaging only (Provides, quilt series, README); library code and tests unchanged, so no library tests were rerun

limits: Hardware-cursor plane path reviewed, not executed
